name: create_reminder
description: Create a reminder or calendar event that syncs to Google Calendar and triggers TTS notification. Use when user says: 'remind me', 'set a reminder', 'add to calendar', 'schedule', 'create event', 'calendar event', etc. Supports natural time expressions like 'in 30 minutes', 'in 4 hours', 'tomorrow at 3pm', 'Wednesday at 11am', 'every Wednesday at 2pm', 'every month on the 10th'. Recurring reminders auto-reschedule. Syncs bidirectionally with Google Calendar.

description.description: Optional additional details about the reminder

when.description: Natural time expression: 'in 30 minutes', 'in 4 hours', 'in 2 days', 'tomorrow at 3pm', 'at 5pm', 'every Wednesday', 'every month on the 10th', 'every Friday at 2pm', etc. Use the user's expressed time directly. Supports one-time and recurring reminders.
